name: Mystic
description: Mystic image generation model for ultra-realistic, high-resolution images.

action.description: Mystic image generation model for ultra-realistic, high-resolution images.
action.name: fp_mystic

adherence.description: Note: This parameter only takes effect when a "Style Image" is provided. Increasing this value will make your generation more faithful to the prompt, but it may transfer the style a bit less accurately. Higher values can help fix small artifacts, anatomical errors and text readability. Lower values will give you more creative images and closer to the style reference.
adherence.title: Adherence

aspect_ratio.description: Image size with the aspect ratio. The aspect ratio is the proportional relationship between an image's width and height, expressed as *_width_height (e.g., square_1_1, widescreen_16_9).
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

creative_detailing.description: Higher values can achieve greater detail per pixel at higher resolutions at the cost of giving a somewhat more "HDR" or artificial look. Very high values can generate quite crazy things like eyes where they shouldn't appear, etc.
creative_detailing.title: Creative Detailing

engine.description: Select the engine for the AI model. automatic - default choice, Illusio - for smoother illustrations, landscapes, and nature. Sharpy - better for realistic images like photographs and for a more grainy look. Sparkle - also good for realistic images. It's a middle ground between Illusio and Sharpy.
engine.title: Engine

fixed_generation.description: When this option is enabled, using the same settings will consistently produce the same image. Fixed generations are ideal for fine-tuning, as it allows for incremental changes to parameters to see subtle variations in the output.
fixed_generation.title: Fixed Generation

hdr.description: Note: This parameter only takes effect when a "Style Image" is provided. Increasing this value can give you a more detailed image, at the cost of a more 'AI look' and slightly worse style transfer. Lower values have a more natural and artistic look but may increase artifacts.
hdr.title: HDR

model.description: zen - for smoother, basic, and cleaner results. fluid - the model that adheres best to prompts with great average quality for all kind of images. realism - with a more realistic color palette. IMPORTANT: You should use Zen or Fluid if you are trying to generate something that is really fantastic or a known character, Realism may not follow your prompt well.
model.title: Model

structure_reference.description: Base64 image to use as structure reference. Using images as structure references allows you to influence the shape of your final image. This feature enables various creative applications such as coloring sketches, transforming cartoons into realistic images, texturing basic 3D models, or converting real images into cartoons.
structure_reference.title: Structure Reference

structure_strength.description: Note: This parameter only takes effect when a "Control Image" image is provided. Allows to maintain the structure of the original image.
structure_strength.title: Control Image Strength

style_reference.description: Base64 image to use as style reference. Using images as style references allows you to influence the aesthetic of your creation. This is possibly the most powerful tool of Mystic, as it truly lets you create incredibly unique images.
style_reference.title: Style Reference
